name: Pu Luong food guide
summary: Dinner is the stilt house: Cổ Lũng duck, cơm lam, hill chicken, and jar wine. Bản Đôn, the summit camp, Thác Hiêu, and Phố Đoàn name the other plates. A current price is Check on arrival.
body: You eat on the floor of a stilt house, with the fire outside at Bản Đôn. Ask for Cổ Lũng duck and cơm lam. Stay for that table if the valley is the trip. Mai Châu’s cơm lam and chẩm chéo are that valley’s plates. These lines are what Thanh Hoa sources print for Pù Luông.

The Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism lists măng rừng, vịt cỏ, lợn rừng, gà đồi, rau bí, ngọn su su, xôi tím, and ốc đá at Bản Đôn. Vietnam Airlines adds cơm lam, cá suối nướng, măng đắng, and lợn cỏ, and describes the duck as fragrant and low in fat, boiled, grilled, or xáo. Vịt cỏ is not called the Cổ Lũng duck. Lợn rừng is not called lợn cỏ. Măng rừng, măng khô, and măng đắng stay three names. VnExpress adds măng chua.

VietNamNet’s 16 Nov 2025 summit plan names gà nướng, xôi đồ, rượu ngô, and rượu chuối after an arrival at about 15:30. That rice is not xôi tím. Tạp chí Sở hữu trí tuệ, 12 Jul 2024, names xôi hấp gà Kho Mường, lá sắng, and sâu măng with the duck and măng đắng at Thác Hiêu. VnExpress, 3 Jul 2023, adds thịt gác bếp for Thai households in Quan Hóa and Bá Thước, and the forest salads. A breakfast hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

Phố Đoàn meets on Thursday and Sunday. Vietnam Airlines prints a photograph window of 06:30–09:00. The 16 May 2022 and 26 Sep 2026 articles from the Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism name the two weekdays and do not print that clock. Both stand. Hải Vân’s 16 May 2022 article says sellers from old Cổ Lũng leave at 05:00. On 18 Jun 2023 VnExpress quoted a live-duck price and a cooked-bird price at Bản Hiêu. A current price is Check on arrival.
specialtiesLead: The stilt-house table, the summit camp, Thác Hiêu, and the market foods. Phố Đoàn is the market, not one of these plates. A current price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: On the stilt-house table
paragraphs: These are the plates, drinks, and market foods the sources name for this valley. Streets are not on the list. Ask at the house. Where an hour was not printed, the hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Co Lung duck
spots.note: The valley duck. VnExpress, 18 Jun 2023, places the breed at Bản Hiêu, then xã Cổ Lũng: short legs, a white neck ring, brown-and-black feathers on that account and sparrow-colored feathers on 3 Jul 2023. Vietnam Airlines says the meat is fragrant and low in fat, boiled, grilled, or xáo. Xáo is not defined. Dip the boiled bird in chẩm chéo. On 18 Jun 2023 a Bản Hiêu village head quoted 100,000–150,000 đồng a kilogram live and about 200,000–350,000 đồng for a cooked bird of about 1.2–2 kg. A current price is Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grass duck
spots.note: On the Bản Đôn list of 18 Mar 2022 from the Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism. That list does not say this is the Cổ Lũng duck. A method and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Forest bamboo shoot
spots.note: On the Bản Đôn list. VnExpress, 3 Jul 2023, says the spring shoot is bitter when boiled, then sweet. Dried shoot and bitter shoot keep their own names. The hour and the price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dried bamboo shoot
spots.note: A good at Phố Đoàn on the 26 Sep 2026 department article, with honey and banana flower. Not the fresh shoot. Thursday and Sunday. A recipe and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bitter bamboo shoot
spots.note: Vietnam Airlines: a slightly bitter fresh shoot, with a dip or stir-fried with forest pork. Tạp chí Sở hữu trí tuệ, 12 Jul 2024, also names it at Thác Hiêu. Not măng rừng. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Sour bamboo shoot
spots.note: VnExpress, 3 Jul 2023, says Thai cooks make this from the forest shoot and eat it all year in a fish soup. A ferment time was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Hill chicken
spots.note: On the Bản Đôn list. Vietnam Airlines says the birds run free, the meat is firm, the skin is crisp, and the bird is grilled with lá mắc mật. The camp’s gà nướng is a different sentence. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled chicken at the camp
spots.note: VietNamNet, 16 Nov 2025, names gà nướng in the summit-camp supper with xôi đồ, rượu ngô, and rượu chuối, after an arrival printed at about 15:30. It is not called gà đồi. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled stream fish
spots.note: Vietnam Airlines: small stream fish, marinated with forest leaves, grilled. VnExpress adds mắc khén, chili, and lemongrass, and a separate soup of fish with măng chua. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bamboo sticky rice
spots.note: Glutinous rice in a bamboo tube. Vietnam Airlines says it smells of forest bamboo and is soft and rich. VnExpress, 3 Jul 2023, adds upland rice, banana leaf, a wood fire, and sesame salt, and a cooking session at some houses. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Purple sticky rice
spots.note: On the Bản Đôn list. The color source was not printed. Not the camp’s xôi đồ. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Steamed sticky rice at the camp
spots.note: In the summit-camp supper on VietNamNet, 16 Nov 2025. Not xôi tím. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Steamed sticky rice with Kho Muong chicken
spots.note: Named by Tạp chí Sở hữu trí tuệ, 12 Jul 2024, among Thai-Muong dishes of Thác Hiêu. A method was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Rock snail
spots.note: On the Bản Đôn list. The 16 May 2022 market article also says ốc suối and lists ốc núi. Vietnam Airlines: a rainy-season snail, steamed with lemongrass or fried with lime leaf. Bản Đôn prints no season. VnExpress heads it ốc núi, captions a photograph ốc đá, and says boiled, steamed with ginger, a salad, or stir-fried, with chẩm chéo. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Forest pig
spots.note: A name on the Bản Đôn list. A method was not printed. Not called lợn cỏ. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Free-range pig
spots.note: Vietnam Airlines: free-range, fragrant, firm, grilled, steamed, or stir-fried. Not the lợn rừng on the Bản Đôn list. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Meat smoked over the fire
spots.note: VnExpress, 3 Jul 2023: Thai households in Quan Hóa and Bá Thước smoke buffalo or pork belly until the outside is dry, the inside still soft and sweet, and the color dark pink, with mắc khén, chili, and ginger. Most at the start of the year, for Tết and guests. A 26 Sep 2026 department article also names thịt treo gác bếp among highland-market goods, including Phố Đoàn and Na Mèo, with no cut and no smoke time. Both stand. A current price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Pumpkin greens
spots.note: On the Bản Đôn meal, beside ngọn su su. A method was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Chayote tips
spots.note: On the Bản Đôn meal. The 16 May 2022 market article also sees su su carried to Phố Đoàn. A method and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Sang leaf
spots.note: Named with the Thai-Muong dishes of Thác Hiêu on 12 Jul 2024. A method was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Wild banana-flower salad
spots.note: On the Thai table in the 3 Jul 2023 VnExpress account. Hoa chuối is also a good at Phố Đoàn. A dressing was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Male papaya-flower salad
spots.note: On the same VnExpress table. A dressing was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Forest-green salad
spots.note: Named beside the two flower salads on 3 Jul 2023. The leaves were not listed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bitter-leaf soup
spots.note: VnExpress, 3 Jul 2023, cooks canh lá đắng with offal and blood. The leaf was not named. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bamboo grub
spots.note: Named with the Thai-Muong dishes of Thác Hiêu on 12 Jul 2024. A method was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cham cheo
spots.note: Hải Vân, 16 May 2022, builds it from toasted mắc khén, fresh chili, ginger, salt, and herbs, then stirs in more mắc khén. It is a dip for boiled, roasted, and grilled meat, especially boiled Cổ Lũng duck, not a plate on its own in that article. The seed is bought at Phố Đoàn. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Jar wine
spots.note: The Bản Đôn evening: campfire, jar wine, xòe, and khắp, on the 18 Mar 2022 department article. Jars are also at Phố Đoàn on Thursday and Sunday. Not a bar pour. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Corn wine
spots.note: VietNamNet, 16 Nov 2025, says Thai hosts distill it and pour it at the summit-camp supper. A strength was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banana wine
spots.note: The same camp supper, beside rượu ngô. A strength was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Forest honey
spots.note: A good at Phố Đoàn on the 26 Sep 2026 department article, with dried bamboo and banana flower. Thursday and Sunday. A grade and a price are Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Pho Doan market
paragraphs: The meal is still the house. Phố Đoàn is the roadside market, Thursday and Sunday.

spots.name: Pho Doan market
spots.note: The Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism places it in old xã Lũng Niêm on 16 May 2022, and in xã Pù Luông on 26 Sep 2026. Resolution 1686 put old Lũng Niêm into xã Pù Luông from 1 July 2025. Both addresses are the rename. Sellers lay cloth, jar wine, forest greens, ốc núi, and snacks on the verge. The 26 Sep 2026 article names hạt dổi, rau dớn, hoa chuối, măng khô, and mật ong from Thai and Muong sellers. Thursday and Sunday. Vietnam Airlines prints 06:30–09:00 for photographs. The 16 May 2022 and 26 Sep 2026 department articles do not print that clock. Both stand. A stall price is Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Pu Luong food guide — duck, bamboo rice, and the market
seoDescription: Cổ Lũng duck, cơm lam, and jar wine at the stilt house. Phố Đoàn is Thursday and Sunday. A current price is Check on arrival.
